patterns.note: The initial hero section features a single, extremely large animated text element centered on a minimalist light background, contrasting with a dense, multi-column footer revealed on scroll.

The site uses a highly stylized, sculptural 3D font for the main hero identity, paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for all body text, links, and footer headings, creating a strong visual contrast.
A very light, almost pastel green background is consistently used, providing a clean canvas for dark text and vibrant, high-contrast bright green accents for interactive elements and highlights.

The large 3D hero text scales down and translates upwards, animating out of view to reveal a full-bleed video hero as the user scrolls down the page. A 'UP ^' button appears in the bottom right corner when the footer is visible.

The homepage transitions from an initial minimalist hero with a list of project names to a full-width video hero, and finally to a structured, multi-column footer with contact and service information.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes WebGL or canvas animation to render a large, sculptural 3D text element that dynamically scales and translates out of the viewport on scroll, revealing a full-bleed video player beneath it. This creates a dramatic, interactive reveal effect.
Scroll-triggered reveals are employed for the footer content, which fades or slides into view as the user scrolls past the main hero and video sections, ensuring content appears contextually.
A sticky navigation element (the 'ABOUT' link) maintains its position in the top right corner, providing persistent access to key information regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: The hero features an extremely oversized, sculptural 3D text element, contrasting with small, legible body text and moderately sized, bold uppercase headings in the footer.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied across all elements, including buttons, video player, and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: The initial hero and project list exhibit very airy, minimalist spacing, while the footer transitions to a more balanced and dense multi-column layout.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its highly artistic and dynamic hero experience, where a unique, animated 3D text element dramatically transforms to reveal a full-bleed video. This creates an immediate, memorable impression that is both playful and sophisticated, setting it apart from typical static or simple video heroes.
